title: The Revolt at the Ford
summary: A short first mission: the Crown's column crosses the ford and puts down a village revolt.

sides.name: The Crown
sides.about: The Crown's column, sent to put down the revolt.

sides.name: The Rebels
sides.about: The villagers who have risen against the Crown.

objectives.text: Take the ford with five men.
Hold the village: the whole county will rise with you.

i1.text: Zounds, Sergeant, a whole village in arms against the Crown! Over the ford, and we'll have this done by supper.

i2.text: Farmers with muskets, sir. By my troth, they'll run at the first volley. Most of them.

tip1.text: Pick your men with a box, sir, and right-click the ground to march them. The ford is to the west.

r1.text: The Crown's lobsters are at the ford, lads. Hold this village and the whole county rises with us!

r2.text: Keep the Town Hall standing. Train what men you can at the barracks.

f1.text: They're firing from the far bank, the knaves!

tip2.text: Keep the muskets in a line, sir, and let the rascals come to us. Right-click a man to shoot at him.

m1.text: Out, out! Drive the poltroons back into the river!

ft1.text: The ford is ours. On to the village, and burn their hall!

h1.text: The Crown's horse, Captain! Point us at the rapscallions!

b1.text: Hold, lads! Hold for the county!

rd1.text: Their ringleader is down! The varlets are wavering, sir!

muster.caption: The Crown's column musters on the east bank at dawn; the rebel village smokes across the river.

rebel_banner.caption: Villagers with muskets and scythes under a home-made banner, the Town Hall behind them.

hall_burns.caption: The rebels' Town Hall burns; the Crown's colours fly over the ford.

county_rises.caption: Beacons on every hill: the county has risen against the Crown.

text: The year 2500. The great machines are long gone; the world fights with muskets and sail again.
A village by the ford has risen against the Crown. You lead the column sent to end it.
Cross the ford and burn the rebels' Town Hall. Keep Captain Hale alive.
The year 2500. The great machines are long gone; the world fights with muskets and sail again.
Your village has risen against the Crown, and the Crown's column is at the ford.
Hold the village for eight minutes and the whole county will rise with you.

crown.title: The revolt is crushed
crown.text: The village is quiet again. But the Crown's eyes turn to stranger troubles: things in the deep earth, and machines that tick.

rebels.title: The county rises
rebels.text: The column fell back over the ford, and beacons burn on every hill. The Crown has bigger troubles coming.
